method: Warm both modules; fixed identical request inputs; alternate AB/BA serially with no parallel generation; independent new seed cohort plus separately reported regression cases with exact original ledgers; replay mode uses the archived independent requests verbatim. Each independent seed uses a fixed original pre-mode ledger, NOT divergent per-arm rolling history. Fixed baseline validator runs in a separate VM.
timingScope: Synchronous Node generation wall time and process CPU, excluding independent validation. Not a real browser or Windows test. >8000ms never counted as UI delivery; <=8000ms still is not proof of UI delivery. Single timing sample per seed/arm, not statistical performance certification.
